scope:
Integrate one explicit four-stage variant through material/receiver/plant ledgers.

No run discovery or implicit mixing of source, mesh, EOS, or nuclear-rate revisions.
Metadata adapters preserve the exact physical records and initial profiles while
supplying declared physical duration and trace paths to the existing reducer.
Archived results embed the reduced inputs for replay without raw hydro traces.

record.initial_profile_description: Mixture sensitivity A, H/catalyst=3.0; fixed_energy; fixed pulse mass, density and temperature profiles.
record.message: The solver successfully reached the end of the integration interval.
limitations: specified convergent flow; its preparation and driver are not modeled
spherical symmetry; no multidimensional instabilities or mixing
no screening or Coulomb EOS correction
27-isotope network truncated at Mg
constant opacity if radiation enabled; no electron conduction
hot beta Q entirely assigned to neutrinos, conservatively
no catalyst processing, cold-decay, collection or plant-mass model

held_fixed: physical final time unless temperature guard
total prepared energy at stated reference multiplier
mixture_inputs.scope: Full 27-isotope spherical hydro sensitivity; prescribed hot inflow; constant grey opacity. Source preparation, 3D merger and apparatus not simulated.

source_rating.scope: 60% preparation efficiency. Actual initial composition and EOS; launch-time bins retain historical centroid allocation for comparison, with exact half-cell kinetic allocation separately reported. No switching/focusing overhead is inferred.

prompt.scope: Named mass-weighted radiation accumulator, no renormalization. Surface-deposition thermal upper reference; spectrum-dependent depth, angular smearing and material phase changes are separate.

ballistic.literal_full_clearance: Infinite for uniform central-cell dm/dv extending to zero. Full_resolved is a finite shell-representative diagnostic; the retained slow core needs its own route.

thermal.scope: Semi-infinite constant-property carbon, no surface radiation/cooling. Actual mass-conserving velocity histogram; per-cell residual internal energy advected as an upper scenario. Subsequent pressure acceleration or radiation changes its partition. Delayed nuclear decay is not included in this material or prompt screen.

energy_channels_J.future_decay: Separate nuclear ledger required; no fixed-stage beta inventory assumed.

receiver.scope: Cached generalized receiver requirements, conditional on ballistic continuation of this actual mixture. Complete mass retained; no mass normalization to nodal kinetic energy. Not a validated apparatus or permanent matter-loss calculation.

capacity_plant.scope: Conditional stationary heat/power/mass requirements. Hot eligibility, insulation, converter/HX/pump ratings and cold-sky view require hardware qualification. Original generic services retained; named HX and pump hardware are incremental allocations.
capacity_plant.surface_proxy_scope: Sum of separate maxima in constant-property carbon; prompt mathematical-surface deposition is an intentionally conservative reference, not a qualified physical temperature. Finite spectral penetration and delayed heat require separate treatment.
capacity_plant.processing_cost_scope: These named H-processing loads are compared with the retained ordinary-auxiliary allowance; they are not additional debits on top of an allowance already intended to cover processing. New requirements exceeding that allowance must be added explicitly.
capacity_plant.qualification: Conditional integrated accounting point. Source formation, receiver recovery and guide/thermal hardware remain engineering candidates.
